messages:
maria-cs: FYI onboarding sync with Fathom Health tomorrow. They've flagged SLO alignment and want clarity on how we report uptime + latency, and how credits would be calculated if targets miss. Can @ben-se and @julia-prod weigh in so I can prep the one-pager for renewal?

ben-se: quick context — Fathom is on Hosted API (multi-tenant) right now, not Dedicated. That affects how we define what counts as ‘availability’ vs customer-isolated incidents. For hosted: we compute monthly uptime per region and per model route.

julia-prod: recommend we present two SLO layers: 1) Platform SLA (what Redwood guarantees) — e.g., 99.95% monthly uptime, automatic credits tiers. 2) Performance SLO (p95 latency for generation calls) — measured at token-gen endpoint, e.g., p95 < 250ms for seq_len <= 512. Make clear the measurement windows and excluded maintenance windows.

maria-cs: nice. Fathom asked specifically how credits are calculated — they saw a past latency spike in Jan and want to know if that will hit their renewal. Any simple formula we can show?

ben-se: simple breakdown we use internally:
```
monthly_uptime = 1 - (sum_downtime_seconds / seconds_in_billing_month)
if monthly_uptime < 0.9995:
  credit_pct = min( (0.9995 - monthly_uptime) / 0.0005 * 0.25, 0.5 )  # sample tiers
else:
  credit_pct = 0
```
This is illustrative — actual contract language is slightly different and has exclusions (force majeure, customer networking issues).

deploy-bot: Incident 2025-11-07T03:12:22Z — region-us-east degraded p95 latency (affected routes: /v1/generate). Root cause: transient cache invalidation on allocator-3. Auto-retries restored service after ~18m.

sam-acct-mgr: That incident is the one Fathom pulled into the renewal discussion. If we show the report with context (root cause + mitigations) and the credit calc example, I think we can neutralize renewal risk. They want monthly cadence and an SLA appendix in the MSA.

ben-se: we should also show the latency distribution + how KV prefix caching affects p95. For Fathom's workload (lots of short prompts), cache hit ratio matters a lot. I'll attach a couple of sample graphs to the one-pager: monthly uptime heatmap and p95 by hour for the last 90 days.

julia-prod: action items:
- @ben-se provide graphs + the sample credit calc snippet (by EOD)
- @maria-cs draft the one-pager with: SLA summary, measurement definitions, incident note for Nov event, and recommended operations playbook for them
- @sam-acct-mgr confirm whether they want the SLA appendix in MSA or as a separate addendum

maria-cs: ack. I'll draft and send to this thread for review before the customer call. Planning to include: monitoring access (read-only), monthly emailed SLO report, and a quarterly deep-dive. Any objections?

ben-se: no objections. add a short blurb about fallback policy — e.g., automatic routing to compatible model variant if latency spikes, and how that affects token accounting.

sam-acct-mgr: +1. Also confirm billing implications for credits — ops will apply credits to next invoice automatically unless legal requires different flow.

maria-cs: perfect, thanks. I'll ping once the draft is up. :thumbsup:

julia-prod: thanks all — happy to review wording for legal clarity.
